channel.title: B. Mello Ag Services — Reports
channel.description: Central Valley field conditions, ag crime, commodity and fuel markets.

item.title: Weekly Fishing Report: The fall salmon opener limited out
item.description: Eighteen of twenty-two boats came in at limits on the September 1 opener — 540 kings on 282 rods and a 33-pounder at Bodega. Pine Flat is under 18 percent, the upper Kings and the Kern both came back up, and minus tides run Sunday through Wednesday.

item.title: Field Report: Harvest running early, and the sampling window just got shorter
item.description: Almond harvest ahead of schedule and a short pistachio crop against 600–900 million lb industry estimates. The post-harvest nutrition window, and a wet-winter forecast that shortens the fall soil sampling season.

item.title: Weekly Energy Update: The world market turned this week and California did not
item.description: Crude fell 4 to 6% on Hormuz corridor talks and the record diesel crack came off its high — but California diesel still added 15 cents to $7.295.

item.title: Weekly Fishing Report: San Francisco salmon closed a week early
item.description: Fisheries service took inseason action on August 19 and shut the area after Sunday the 23rd. Monterey has six days left, the fall season opens September 1, and the bottom went 16 for 17 at limits.

item.title: Weekly Energy Update: The gap closed, exactly as we said it would
item.description: Diesel refining margins set an all-time record above $100 a barrel and California diesel jumped 20¢ in a week to $7.142.

item.title: Weekly Fishing Report: Rockfish and lingcod still wide open
item.description: Thirteen days left on the salmon season, only 2 of 10 trips at limits, and the fall striper run is pouring into the Delta.

item.title: Weekly Energy Update: The dip is over
item.description: Drones hit two tankers in the Strait of Hormuz and diesel futures rose almost 10% in five days — but the pump still priced last week's low.

item.title: Economic Update: Book fall soil sampling now
item.description: An El Niño winter may shorten the post-harvest window. Class I skim drops $2.73, CVP allocation raised, corn $4.48, wheat $6.52.

item.title: Weekly Fishing Report: New moon Thursday, last minus tides until Aug 25
item.description: The salmon fleet cooled off hard — 5 of 29 trips at limits — Fort Bragg is now closed, and Pine Flat is down 10.7 feet in six weeks.

item.title: Weekly Energy Update: The break we said would need a Hormuz deal showed up
item.description: Both crude benchmarks fell more than 7% and California pump prices finally turned lower.

item.title: Weekly Fishing Report: Salmon limits off the Gate, fish to 32 lb
item.description: The best minus tides of the month land Aug 10–12 right alongside the new moon. Fort Bragg salmon closes Aug 10.

item.title: Weekly Energy Update: The relief did not come
item.description: Brent closed July at $90.12 — its strongest month since March — and California diesel pushed to $6.91. We look higher again this week.

item.title: Field Report: Harvest season is here
item.description: Almond harvest starts early and the pistachio off-year crop runs short. Silage corn chopping, cotton into cutout, pomegranate split — and why post-harvest soil sampling matters now.

item.title: Weekly Energy Update: Another leg up on Hormuz risk and $90 crude
item.description: Diesel and gasoline both moved higher again last week. Here is what it means for your fuel budget.

item.title: Special Report: Sulfur Price Alert
item.description: Global conflict is tightening sulfur supply — about $890/MT Qatar FOB, up roughly 300% year over year, with Russia's export ban running through Dec 31. If you can pre-pay and take delivery, do it now.

item.title: Economic Update: Milk, fuel, futures and the 2026 pistachio crop
item.description: Corn around $4.38, wheat $6.32, Class III at $16.15, California diesel about $6.07 — plus the water situation and Central Valley weather.

item.title: Holiday: Happy Independence Day
item.description: Land of the free, because of the brave — from the B. Mello Ag Services family.

item.title: Field Report: Almond hull split underway
item.description: Cotton at peak bloom, wheat harvest wrapping up, table grape harvest active. Spotlight: compost and soil/water testing while commercial nitrogen stays expensive.

item.title: Holiday: Happy Father's Day
item.description: Thank you for planting the seeds of hard work, values, and a strong future.

item.title: Holiday: Honoring our heroes this Memorial Day
item.description: B Mello Ag Services honors the brave men and women who gave all for our freedom.

item.title: Economic Update: Class III under pressure as the flush peaks
item.description: Cheese and butter mixed, corn around $4.35, wheat $5.52, and California diesel at $7.89.

item.title: Field Report: Full gear across the Valley
item.description: The hull split window nears, pistachios are in post-bloom nut fill, corn and cotton planting are active. Spotlight: JABB SBb 2.5™ and Nitryx™.

item.title: Economic Update: Record cow numbers cap Class III
item.description: Strong production keeps futures capped near $16.00, and California diesel hits an all-time high at $7.73.

item.title: Holiday: Happy Easter
item.description: May you be surrounded by the love of family and the sound of children's laughter.

item.title: Field Report: One of the highest-leverage months in the Valley
item.description: Pistachio bloom is active, wheat prices are firming, and almond hull split is on an August target. Spotlight: Premium 97™ and Premium 95™ HA.
